notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
description:
Gain any amount of life.
Trudge Garden triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a 4/4 Fungus Beast creature token.
The Fungus Beast enters the battlefield, triggering Anointer Priest.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Fungus Beast, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Anointer Priest trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.
